verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a tax-calculation engine, but nothing in the evidence shows AvaTax validating VAT or tax IDs against official registries in real time, or applying reverse charge to B2B cross-border sales. The closest items cover other capabilities and are not credited: general 200+ country rate coverage, cross-border duties and landed cost, VAT return reporting, and e-invoicing format validations.

support.subject: As a developer, B2B cross-border sales are handled correctly — VAT and tax IDs validated against official registries in real time, reverse charge applied when it should be
